name: Overgrowth
description: Rings a tile up to %cast_range% tiles away with Branchlings for %duration% turns, each dealing %branch_dmg% damage to adjacent enemies and healing adjacent allies %branch_heal% every turn.
details: Tiles that are already occupied are skipped.
Overlapping Branchlings stack, so a unit beside two of them is hit or healed twice.

upgrade.summary: A slain Branchling leaves a Branchigga standing in its place.
details: Tiles that are already occupied are skipped.
Overlapping Branchlings stack, so a unit beside two of them is hit or healed twice.
Killing a Branchling grows a Branchigga where it fell - a real unit that moves, attacks, and carries the same aura.
A Branchigga lasts %branchigga_duration% turns from the moment it sprouts. Branchlings that simply expire leave nothing behind, and Sprout's Branchling never grows one.
